content.text: Five records, so I'll page with limit 2.

The local database has five Google workouts from October 1–3, 2026. I retrieved them in three requests of two records or fewer.

| Date | Start time | Source ID | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| Oct 1 | 10:00 | workout-0 | 20 min |
| Oct 1 | 10:00 | workout-1 | 30 min |
| Oct 2 | 10:00 | workout-2 | 40 min |
| Oct 2 | 10:00 | workout-3 | 50 min |
| Oct 3 | 10:00 | workout-4 | 60 min |

- **Total time:** The five workouts add up to 200 minutes.
- **Overlapping start times:** Two workouts on Oct 1 and two on Oct 2 show the same 10:00 start time. They may be separate sessions or duplicate entries, and the data doesn't say which.
- **Missing details:** The records have no activity type, only a duration.
- **Local data only:** This comes from the local database, which may not include workouts that haven't been synced. I didn't run a sync.
- **Synthetic parser tag:** Each record is tagged with the parser name "eval-synthetic", so these may be test data rather than real workouts.
